children: Galaxy Entertainment Group (0027) said it will donate a combined MOP10 million with the Lui Che Woo Family Foundation to support emergency rescue and post-disaster reconstruction after a severe mudslide hit Jilong Port in Jilong County, Xigaze City, Tibet Autonomous Region, according to Ming Pao.

The company said the donation will be made through the Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in the Macao Special Administrative Region to assist relief efforts and rebuilding work in the affected area.

title: Galaxy Entertainment, Lui Che Woo Family Foundation Donate MOP10 Million for Tibet Disaster Relief
